_about: Open-ended prompts used to check whether the model gets stuck repeating itself.
prompts: Write a short paragraph about a walk through a forest in autumn.
Explain why the sky looks blue during the day.
Describe your ideal weekend in a few sentences.
Tell a short story about a robot who learns to cook.
What are some tips for learning a new language?
Describe the city of the future.
Write a product description for a reusable water bottle.
Explain how a bicycle works to a ten-year-old.
Summarize the benefits of reading every day.
